# AZAFCO International - Fresh Fish Export Company

> Leading Egyptian company specialized in fresh fish packaging and export since 2008.

## Company Information
- Name: AZAFCO International (ازافكو العالمية)
- Legal name: AZAFCO International for Investment and Development S.A.E.
- Arabic legal name: ازافكو العالمية للاستثمار والتنمية (ش.م.م)
- Legal form: Egyptian joint-stock company (S.A.E., شركة مساهمة مصرية) under Law 159/1981
- Commercial Register: No. 100776
- Industry: Fresh Fish Export, Seafood B2B Supply
- Founded: 2008
- Location: Industrial Zone, Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt
- Website: https://azafco.com.eg
- Contact: +201007736419, business@azafco.com.eg

## What We Do
AZAFCO is a B2B fresh fish supplier and exporter from Egypt. We serve restaurants, hotels, distributors, and wholesale buyers in the Middle East, Gulf region, Europe, and worldwide.

## Products Available
1. Tilapia (بلطي) - Oreochromis niloticus - Freshwater, farmed - Sizes: 200-500g+
2. Sea Bass (قاروص) - Dicentrarchus labrax - Marine, farmed - Sizes: 400-600g+
3. Grey Mullet (بوري) - Mugil cephalus - Brackish water, farmed - Sizes: 150-400g
4. Grass Carp (حشايش) - Ctenopharyngodon idella - Freshwater, farmed - Sizes: on request
5. Common Carp (قشرة) - Cyprinus carpio - Freshwater, farmed - Sizes: 1-2kg+
6. Catfish (قراميط) - Clarias gariepinus - Freshwater - Sizes: 500-800g+
7. Meagre (لوت) - Argyrosomus regius - Marine, farmed - Sizes: 400-600g+
8. Thinlip Mullet (طوبار) - Chelon ramada - Brackish water, farmed - Sizes and availability: on request
9. Bayad Catfish (بياض) - Bagrus bajad - Freshwater, mostly wild-caught - Sizes and availability: on request
10. Silver Carp (سلفر) - Hypophthalmichthys molitrix - Freshwater, farmed - Sizes and availability: on request
11. Mirror Carp (مبروكة) - Cyprinus carpio (mirror variety) - Freshwater, farmed - Sizes and availability: on request
12. Sea Bream (دنيس) - Sparus aurata - Marine, farmed - Sizes and availability: on request
13. European Eel (ثعابين السمك) - Anguilla anguilla - Brackish water - Sizes: 300-500g+ (not offered to EU buyers)

## Export Markets
UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Russia, Spain, United Kingdom, Germany, France, United States.

## Quality Certifications
- ISO 22000 (Food Safety)
- HACCP (Hazard Analysis)
- ISO 9001 (Quality Management)

- ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety)
- EU Export Approved

## Packaging & Storage
- Packaging: EPS Foam Boxes (صندوق فوم)
- Storage Temperature: 0 to 4°C
- Cold Chain: Complete refrigerated logistics

## Monthly Capacity
+2500 tons/month fresh fish export capacity

## Key Facts
- 15+ countries served
- 2 processing factories (Motobas since 2008, Baltim since 2018)
- Fresh fish direct from Egyptian farms
- B2B wholesale only (no retail)
